mapper.sql: FROM bike_factory_sales_order o JOIN bike_customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id LEFT JOIN bike_warehouse w ON w.id=o.warehouse_id

where.if: AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_user_customer_scope cs WHERE cs.user_id=#{scopeUser} AND cs.customer_id=o.customer_id)
AND (o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.details_json,'$.contractNo')) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_factory_sales_order SET customer_id=#{r.customerId},warehouse_id=#{r.warehouseId},business_type=#{r.businessType},currency_code=#{r.currencyCode},details_json=#{details},revision=revision+1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND revision=#{r.revision}
UPDATE bike_factory_sales_order SET steps_json=#{steps},revision=revision+1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.select: SELECT o.id,o.order_no,i.ordered_qty order_qty,i.shipped_qty,o.status FROM bike_factory_sales_order_link l JOIN bike_sales_order o ON o.id=l.order_id JOIN bike_sales_order_item i ON i.order_id=o.id WHERE l.factory_order_id=#{id} ORDER BY o.id
SELECT factory_order_id FROM bike_factory_sales_order_link WHERE order_id=#{orderId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bike_factory_sales_order_link WHERE factory_order_id=#{id} AND order_id=#{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM bike_sales_settlement WHERE subject_type=#{type} AND subject_id=#{subjectId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT FROM bike_sales_settlement WHERE subject_type=#{type} AND subject_id=#{subjectId} AND request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_sales_settlement SET status='REVERSED',reversed_by=#{operatorId},reversed_at=NOW(3),reversal_reason=#{reason} WHERE subject_type=#{type} AND subject_id=#{subjectId} AND id=#{id} AND status='CONFIRMED'

UPDATE bike_sales_settlement SET counterparty=#{r.counterparty},reference_no=#{r.referenceNo},remark=#{r.remark} WHERE subject_type=#{type} AND subject_id=#{subjectId} AND id=#{id} AND status='CONFIRMED'
